Version: 20260825v1
1. Stripe Checkout flows.
2. Stripe Elements (CPM) single-payment POC using Stripe Payment Intents + Plaid Auth / Link. Plaid is used to connect/verify the customer's bank account; HSBC's ACH engine executes the actual ACH payment.
3. Common endpoints / refund flows.

Correct Plaid Auth chain: /link/token/create -> Plaid Link frontend -> public_token + selected account_id -> /item/public_token/exchange -> access_token -> /auth/get -> bank account/routing details -> HSBC ACH engine.

item.name: 2. Stripe Elements (CPM)
2.1 - Single Payment

exec: console.log("[Elements CPM] Payment Intent ID:", jsonData.id);

request.description: Creates the PaymentIntent used by Stripe Payment Element. The CPM ID is NOT sent in this API request; `stripe_cpm_id` is used later by Stripe.js in the frontend `customPaymentMethods` configuration. The test script stores the PaymentIntent ID and client_secret.

Plaid Auth step 1. Omni Collect calls `/link/token/create` with `products=[auth]`. Plaid returns `link_token`, stored as `plaid_link_token`. The frontend uses this token to initialize Plaid Link. After the customer authenticates and selects a bank account, Plaid Link `onSuccess` returns a temporary `public_token` and metadata containing the selected Plaid `account_id`.

exec: if (!publicToken) { throw new Error("Missing plaid_public_token. Complete Plaid Link first and copy the public_token returned by onSuccess."); }

request.description: Plaid Auth step 2. CHAIN: Plaid Link returns `public_token`; populate `plaid_public_token`. Omni Collect calls `/item/public_token/exchange`, which returns `access_token` and `item_id`. The test script stores both. The `access_token` is used by `/auth/get`.

exec: if (!accessToken) { throw new Error("Missing plaid_access_token. Run 2.1.3 first."); }

request.description: Plaid Auth step 3. CHAIN: uses the `plaid_access_token` returned by 2.1.3. Plaid `/auth/get` returns bank-account data including ACH account and routing details. Retain the frontend-selected `plaid_selected_account_id` so Omni Collect can use the matching account from this response. These bank details are then passed to HSBC's proprietary ACH engine. Plaid does not create or settle the ACH transaction.

item.description:
Single-payment CPM POC.
1) Stripe /v1/payment_intents -> client_secret.
2) Frontend renders Stripe Payment Element with the CPM.
3) If ACH CPM selected, Omni Collect calls Plaid /link/token/create with products=[auth] -> link_token.
4) Frontend opens Plaid Link with link_token; customer authenticates/selects one bank account.
5) Plaid Link onSuccess -> public_token + selected account_id.
6) Omni Collect calls /item/public_token/exchange -> access_token + item_id.
7) Omni Collect calls /auth/get -> ACH bank account/routing details.
8) HSBC ACH engine executes the actual ACH payment.
Plaid Transfer APIs are intentionally not used.

Stripe Elements Custom Payment Method (CPM) POC using Plaid Auth / Link. Stripe provides the payment-option UI; Plaid Link/Auth connects and verifies the customer's bank account; HSBC's ACH engine performs the actual ACH payment.
